observations: Photo 0: A pink melodica (wind-blown keyboard instrument) open in its case, showing white/black keys, a plastic mouthpiece tube, and a separate blow pipe attachment.
Photo 1: The closed pink case, embossed with the word 'YAMAHA' on the front, resting among other music gear (mic stands, boxes, speaker cables).

Photo 2: A different, grey/white case of similar shape sitting beside what looks like a full-size electronic keyboard with worn keys and small buttons above them — this appears to be a separate, unrelated item or a mismatched photo.
No clear model number or serial plate is visible in any photo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / AVANT-GARDE MUSIC' overlays all three images, suggesting they are reposted from another listing rather than freshly taken by this seller.

claims.claim: "If you need a keyboard that will fit into your budget..."
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show a melodica (mouth-blown reed instrument), not an electronic keyboard; photo 2 shows an unrelated electronic keyboard, creating ambiguity about what is actually for sale.

risks.risk: Whether the melodica's reeds and air seal still work (no air leakage, no stuck keys).
risks.proof: A short video of someone blowing into it and playing a scale, showing consistent sound across all keys.

risks.risk: Hygiene/condition of the mouthpiece and hose, since melodicas are mouth-blown and secondhand units often have wear or mold inside the tube.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the inside of the mouthpiece and hose.

risks.risk: Whether the item from photo 2 (a full electronic keyboard) is actually included or is a separate unrelated listing mixed in by mistake.
risks.proof: A single photo showing both items together with a note on what is included in this specific sale.
risks.if_unproven: treated as not included, since it cannot be tied to this advert's described item

risks.risk: Authenticity of Yamaha branding versus a rebadged/clone case.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any serial number sticker or logo detail under better lighting.

proof_requests: A video of the melodica being played across its full key range to confirm it produces sound.
Clarification and photo confirming whether the electronic keyboard in photo 2 is part of this sale or a different listing.
A clear photo of the mouthpiece/hose interior for hygiene check.
A close-up of any serial number or model sticker on the case or keybed.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Yamaha-branded melodica in used condition, but no comparable listings for this kind of item were provided, so no price range can be set even at worst-case condition.
